mapper.select: SELECT a.`id` AS "id", a.`theme` AS "theme", a.`safety_education_type` AS "safetyEducationType", a.`start_time` AS "startTime", a.`participants` AS "participants", a.`participants_name` AS "participantsName", a.`safety_status` AS "safetyStatus", a.`participation_type` AS "participationType", a.`attachment_url` AS "attachmentUrl", a.`create_time` AS "createTime", a.`update_time` AS "updateTime", a.`status` AS "status" FROM `swm_safety_education` a WHERE a.`status` = 0 ORDER BY a.update_time DESC

SELECT a.`id` AS "id", a.`theme` AS "theme", a.`content_description` AS "contentDescription", a.`safety_education_type` AS "safetyEducationType", a.`start_time` AS "startTime", a.`participants` AS "participants", a.`participants_name` AS "participantsName", a.`safety_status` AS "safetyStatus", a.`participation_type` AS "participationType", a.`attachment_url` AS "attachmentUrl", a.`create_time` AS "createTime", a.`update_time` AS "updateTime", a.`status` AS "status" FROM `swm_safety_education` a WHERE a.`status` = 0 AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1 FROM `swm_person` p WHERE p.`identity_card` = #{identityCard} AND p.`status` = '0' AND (
( a.`participants` IS NOT NULL AND a.`participants` != '' AND JSON_VALID(a.`participants`) = 1 AND JSON_CONTAINS(a.`participants`, JSON_QUOTE(p.`id`)) ) OR
( a.`participants` IS NOT NULL AND a.`participants` != '' AND FIND_IN_SET(p.`id`, a.`participants`) > 0 ) OR
( a.`participants` IS NOT NULL AND a.`participants` != '' AND a.`participants` LIKE CONCAT('%', p.`id`, '%') ) ) ) ORDER BY a.start_time DESC, a.update_time DESC
